# Bhasura Suseen Gunawardhana > Bhasura Suseen Gunawardhana — PhD student in Visual Computing & Interactive Media at Texas A&M University, working at the intersection of computer graphics, computer vision, HCI, and XR. MS in Computer Science (University of Houston), 3+ years in training & simulation engineering. Explore portfolio, publications, and CV. This file follows the [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org/) convention: a concise, machine-readable summary of this site for AI assistants, search agents, and other LLM-based tools. The canonical, human-facing version of this content lives at https://bhasurasuseen.github.io/. ## About I am a Ph.D. student in Visual Computing &amp; Interactive Media at Texas A&amp;M University. My research interests lie at the intersection of computer graphics, computer vision, HCI, and XR, focusing on fundamental graphics, vision, and interaction problems that enable intuitive, immersive, and human-centered systems. As intelligent technologies advance, I believe asking the right questions is more important than ever.I earned my Master’s degree in Computer Science from the University of Houston and my Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science from the University of Colombo, Sri Lanka. I also have over three years of professional experience as a Software Engineer in the training and simulation industry. ## Pages - [Home / About](https://bhasurasuseen.github.io/): Bio and a one-page scrollable overview of everything below. - [Technical Projects](https://bhasurasuseen.github.io/technical/): Engineering and technical work across visual computing, web, IoT, and games. - [Portfolio](https://bhasurasuseen.github.io/portfolio/): Creative and design work. - [Publications](https://bhasurasuseen.github.io/publications/): Academic and research publications. - [CV](https://bhasurasuseen.github.io/cv/): Education, experience, and skills. - [Contact](https://bhasurasuseen.github.io/contact/): Email, LinkedIn, GitHub, and other ways to get in touch. ## Elsewhere - LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/bhasura-gunawardhana - GitHub: https://github.com/BhasuraSuseen - GitLab: https://gitlab.com/BhasuraSuseen - Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=5FgRyXcAAAAJ - YouTube: https://youtube.com/@azimotion2708 - Behance: https://www.behance.net/bhasurasd682
